title.narrative: Saudi Hearing Volunteer Program for Cochlear Implantation and Auditory Rehabilitation

description.narrative: 1- Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover their treatment costs. 2- Performing surgeries. 3- Providing patients with their medication needs as needed. 4- Alleviating the suffering of many patients who need surgical intervention. 5- Health education for all those receiving treatment for prevention. 6- Assisting the Ministry of Health in the host country that suffers from a shortage of medical staff.
Performing 40 cochlear implant surgeries and distributing 125 hearing aids
Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover the costs of their treatment in the field of ear, nose, throat and cochlear implants.
